c: Open the requested item and go to Related records › Catalog Tasks.
say: Open the requested item in the workspace, and go to the catalog tasks list in its related records.

c: Press New. It shows while the item is active, and only to catalog administrators.
say: Press new. It shows while the item is active, and only to catalog administrators, who may create catalog tasks.

c: The task opens with the Requested item set. Add a short description and an Assignment group, then save.
say: The new task opens with the requested item already set. Add a short description and an assignment group, and save.

c: The group is emailed that the task was assigned to it.
say: The group is emailed that the task has been assigned to it.

c: The flow waits only for its own tasks: the item can complete while yours is open. Close yours first.
say: The item's flow waits only for the tasks it created, so the item can complete while your task is still open. Close yours first.
